select top 1 * from (
select iif(month_end_date=convert(varchar(8),getdate()-1,112),convert(varchar(8),eomonth(dateadd(mm,-1,getdate())),112),convert(varchar(8),getdate()-1,112)) s_date,

from dbo.ODS_MD_SO_SCHEDULE
) t order by s_date asc
